slice: Follow-on wiring 3 — the deterministic Enzyme-call proposer (ℐ : ε → (o, θ))
phase: R2 (spec) — internal wiring; the reference's own ℐ is app-layer, so there is no parity half
authored_from: 3B1B — Curated UI - Formal Execution.md §VIII (effect-first capture); and the two named residuals it discharges — UI-11's 'named core slice' and EVT-15's un-produced EnzymeCall
note: The LAST of the three follow-on wirings. Both residuals asked for the same missing piece and each said so in its own row; this builds it once.

★★_the_STEP_0_reconcile.★★★_1_the_two_residuals_ARE_one_consumer: UI-11 was deferred with an explicit condition: 'queue it as a real core slice WHEN A RUST-SIDE CALLER EXISTS — the natural one is an Enzyme-call proposer over `Definition` + `Registry`, WHICH IS ALSO WHAT EVT-15's `EnzymeCall` RESIDUAL WOULD CONSUME. Until then it stays app-layer, and the reason is a missing consumer rather than a missing capability.' EVT-15 shipped `EnzymeCall` with NO producer at all — grep-confirmed: every one in the crate was hand-built in a test (`EnzymeCall::new(...)` in `semantic.rs` and `stranding.rs` test modules, nowhere else). One piece, wanted twice.
★★_the_STEP_0_reconcile.★★★_2_but_the_discharge_is_SCOPED_HONEST: EVT-15's residual is worded 'EnzymeCall not wired to `execute` (nothing yet RECORDS an EnzymeCall when an operator runs)' — that is the OTHER direction, a recorder over the host's call log. This slice builds the PROPOSER: description → candidate call. It gives `EnzymeCall` a real producer and gives `replay_under` something it did not have to be handed by hand, which is the half that was blocking UI-11. It does NOT make `execute` write a call log, because that log is HOST STATE (a durable per-sustain history, exactly like the capture history UI-11 named as app-layer). Both halves are stated in the tracker rather than one being claimed for the other.
★★_the_STEP_0_reconcile.★★★_3_θ_IS_DECLARED_HERE_WHERE_THE_REFER: UI-11's row says 'θ from the Enzyme's real `inspect.signature` so never more fields than it declares'. A Rust operator is an `OperatorFn` reading a `Map<String, Value>` BY NAME — there is NO SIGNATURE TO INTROSPECT — so the honest analogue is a declaration, and `OperatorMeta` gained `params: Vec<ParamDecl>`. The trade goes both ways and both directions are named: a declaration CAN disagree with the body (introspection cannot), but it IS the contract, where an introspected signature is only an accident of how the body was written. The property UI-11 actually cares about survives either way — a proposal can never carry a field the operator does not declare, because `propose_call` only writes names it read off the declaration.
★★_the_STEP_0_reconcile.★★★_4_pocket_matching_GENERALISED_rather: The reference hardcodes matching against pockets. Here a parameter declares `names_within: Some("finances.pockets")` and the proposer matches candidate values against THE KEYS ACTUALLY PRESENT AT THAT PATH IN THIS STATE. So the core never learns what a pocket is, and any sustain that names a collection gets the same behaviour for free — the same declared-rather-than-baked-in move as `Region`'s weights or an invariant's authority.

divergence.statement: The reference's `ℐ` is app-layer (`effect_capture.py`), by the ING rows' own decision about the transducer — so there is no parity half to grep. The counterweight is the two residuals, which between them named this exact consumer, its inputs, and its rules.
divergence.★★★_the_counterweight_is_the_two_named_r: UI-11's row named the caller ('an Enzyme-call proposer over `Definition` + `Registry`'), named the inputs ('a `Definition`, a `Registry` and a state value, all of which this core already holds'), and named the rules this slice had to keep ('a hint that eliminates every candidate is treated as NO hint; history may pre-fill but NEVER SILENTLY and never skips the confirm'). EVT-15's named the missing producer. Neither is a grep, and both are stronger than one: they were written in advance, by the slices that declined to build this early, and they say what it has to do rather than merely that it should exist.

★★_what_this_slice_REUSES_rather_than_re.the output: `semantic::EnzymeCall` — EVT-15's own type, not a parallel one. Proven by handing a proposed call straight to `replay_under` and getting `CallOutcome::Admitted`.
★★_what_this_slice_REUSES_rather_than_re.the operator set: `Definition::operators` ∩ `Registry` — the definition's real allow-list, so an operator outside it is REJECTED rather than fabricated.
★★_what_this_slice_REUSES_rather_than_re.the parameter shape: `OperatorMeta::params`, the declared analogue of the reference's signature introspection.
★★_what_this_slice_REUSES_rather_than_re.the live values: `State::get(path)`'s own dot-path walk, the same reader `Region` uses.

divergence.★★_a_real_design_flaw_a_TEST_caught_not_: The first version narrowed operator candidates using both the operator's NAME segments and words from its own `description`. 'spend 50 from food' then matched `budget.allocate` as well as `budget.spend` — because `budget.allocate`'s description contains the word 'FROM'. A description is prose written for a human; using it as a matching vocabulary turns ordinary English into operator hints, which is precisely the accidental inference this module exists to refuse. Fixed at the root: THE NAME IS THE CONTRACT, THE PROSE IS NOT, so the vocabulary is the dotted name's own segments and nothing else.

the_greppable_false_positives_named_so_n.propose (many hits): `consensus::propose` is a Paxos ballot — hence `propose_call` here, the THIRTY-FOURTH collision.
the_greppable_false_positives_named_so_n.Proposal (many hits): `operative::Proposal` is what an operative puts forward (a `LegalMove` plus who proposed it) — hence `CallProposal`, the THIRTY-FIFTH.
the_greppable_false_positives_named_so_n.infer / inference (reference side): `effect_capture.py`'s `infer()` is the app-layer original this ports the INFERENCE of, not the plumbing around it.

divergence.the_honest_limits: ★★ THE APP-LAYER FEED STAYS APP-LAYER — the transducer (`parse_message`, the SMS shapes) and the capture history arrive as an `Effect`'s `text` and `known`, two plain values; this slice ports the inference, not the plumbing, and UI-10 is untouched. ★★ EVT-15's RECORDER HALF IS NOT BUILT — nothing makes `execute` write a call log, because that log is host state; this closes the producer half only. ★ NUMBER EXTRACTION IS DELIBERATELY DULL — the first token that parses as `f64`, with no currency grammar, because a currency grammar belongs to the transducer. ★★ OPERATOR NARROWING IS EXACT-TOKEN, NOT FUZZY — no stemming, no synonyms, no edit distance; a description that does not contain a name segment falls through to the full candidate set and ASKS, which is the honest behaviour but does mean a real household needs the app layer's richer matching in front of it. ★ ONE QUESTION AT A TIME — `NeedsDisambiguation` reports the FIRST unresolved field in declaration order rather than all of them, matching the reference's own round-trip shape. ★★ AND NOTHING HERE COMMITS — `propose_call` runs no operator and touches no state; turning a candidate into a real act stays the human-gated approval path that follow-on wiring 2 made structural.

inference_cases.name: a_described_effect_becomes_a_candidate_over_the_real_registry
inference_cases.why: ★★★ `ε → (o, θ)`, end to end and over real objects: 'spend 50 from food' resolves the operator from the definition's own allow-list, the pocket from this state's own keys, and the amount from the text — and `from_history` is empty, because nothing here was remembered.

inference_cases.name: the_pocket_is_matched_against_this_states_own_keys
inference_cases.why: ★★ Generic by construction: the core never learns what a pocket is. The parameter declares `names_within` and the candidate values are the keys actually present at that path, so a different sustain naming a different collection gets the same behaviour with no code change.

inference_cases.name: a_proposal_never_carries_a_field_the_operator_does_not_declare
inference_cases.why: ★★★ UI-11's core property, and it survives the declared-instead-of-introspected substitution intact: every key in the proposed `θ` is checked to be one the operator's own `params` list declares, because that list is the only thing the builder ever reads names from.

gap_cases.name: an_unnamed_pocket_is_a_named_gap_with_the_real_options
gap_cases.why: ★★ Not a guess. A description naming no live pocket returns `NeedsDisambiguation` whose options are **this sustain's own** pocket names — the values a human can actually tap — rather than a fabricated best match.

gap_cases.name: a_missing_amount_is_a_gap_with_no_fabricated_options
gap_cases.why: ★ The distinction between *ambiguous* and *missing*. An amount has no enumerable option list, so `options` is EMPTY — manufacturing a tap-list of plausible numbers would be exactly the invention this refuses.

gap_cases.name: a_description_matching_nothing_asks_rather_than_reporting_no_match
gap_cases.why: ★★★ UI-11's own rule, verbatim: *a hint that eliminates every candidate is treated as NO hint*. 'something happened' narrows to zero, so the proposer falls back to the FULL candidate set and asks — it does not report that nothing matches.

rejection_cases.name: an_operator_outside_the_definition_is_rejected
rejection_cases.why: ★★ A proposal naming something the definition does not permit is REJECTED, not fabricated — even when the caller states it explicitly as a known fact. The definition's allow-list is the authority on what exists here.

rejection_cases.name: a_remembered_pocket_that_no_longer_exists_is_rejected_not_proposed
rejection_cases.why: ★★★ History pre-fill is NOT a bypass. A remembered value that names a collection member must still BE one in the current state — a pocket since renamed away is rejected rather than proposed, which is the same staleness discipline OPV-6's history check keeps.

rejection_cases.name: an_operator_with_no_declared_params_cannot_have_a_theta_invented_for_it
rejection_cases.why: ★★ The third honest answer, and the reason declaring nothing is not a lie: an operator with an empty `params` list yields `CannotInfer` naming exactly that, rather than the proposer guessing a shape from the body it cannot see.

candidate_cases.name: a_remembered_value_is_reported_as_remembered
candidate_cases.why: ★★ *History may pre-fill but never silently.* A value taken from `known` is listed in `from_history` and an inferred one is not, so a caller can always show where each field came from rather than presenting a memory as an inference.

candidate_cases.name: proposing_runs_nothing_and_leaves_the_state_alone
candidate_cases.why: ★★★ The output is a CANDIDATE, never an execution. `propose_call` consults the definition, the registry and the state's keys and writes nowhere — asserted byte-identical — so turning it real stays the human-gated approval path.

candidate_cases.name: a_proposed_call_is_exactly_what_evt_15s_replay_consumes
candidate_cases.why: ★★★ THE DISCHARGE, end to end. A proposed `EnzymeCall` is handed straight to EVT-15's own `replay_under` and comes back `CallOutcome::Admitted` — so `EnzymeCall` finally has a producer, and `replay_under` finally has something it was not handed by hand. One slice, both residuals' shared piece.
